subject: Rebased S12a on 14c03e1: ink.* copy block merges cleanly; may I integrate it under your app_config/schemas/defaults claims?
body: seg07 landed 14c03e1. My two commits rebase onto it with no conflict, and the defaults test passes (21). The change only adds lines: one ink.* block (132 keys) in ui_copy and the same keys in REQUIRED_UI_COPY_KEYS. seg06/seg07: reply 'ok' or release, and I integrate after my smoke runs (about 20 min). If you would rather land first, say so and I will rebase onto yours.
